stem.en: What does a flashing red traffic signal mean?

text.en: Slow down and proceed with caution
Stop completely, then proceed when safe
Stop only if other vehicles are present
The signal is broken; treat it as green

explanation.en: A flashing red signal is treated exactly like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop, then proceed when it is safe to do so.

stem.en: What does a flashing yellow traffic signal mean?

text.en: Stop and wait for green
Slow down and proceed with caution
Yield only to pedestrians
Speed up to clear the intersection

explanation.en: A flashing yellow signal means slow down, look both ways, and proceed through the intersection with caution.

stem.en: What shape is a yield sign?

text.en: Octagon
Diamond
Downward-pointing triangle
Pentagon

explanation.en: Yield signs are downward-pointing triangles, white with a red border. They tell you to slow down and give right of way to traffic on the through road.

stem.en: Two cars arrive at a four-way stop at the same time. Which car has the right of way?

text.en: The car going straight
The car on the right
The car on the left
The larger vehicle

explanation.en: When two vehicles arrive at a four-way stop at the same time, the vehicle on the right has the right of way.

stem.en: You are driving on a two-lane undivided road. A school bus traveling in the opposite direction stops with its red lights flashing. What must you do?

text.en: Continue driving — only same-direction traffic must stop
Slow to 10 mph and proceed with caution
Stop completely and remain stopped until the bus moves or the lights stop flashing
Honk to warn other drivers, then continue

explanation.en: On a two-lane undivided road, traffic in BOTH directions must stop for a school bus with flashing red lights. You may proceed only when the bus moves or the lights stop flashing. On a divided highway with an unpaved median or barrier, only same-direction traffic must stop.

stem.en: Under good conditions, what is the minimum following distance you should keep behind the vehicle ahead of you?

text.en: One car length per 10 mph
At least 2 seconds
10 feet at any speed
Half a second

explanation.en: Use the two-second rule: pick a fixed object the car ahead passes, then count 'one-thousand-one, one-thousand-two.' If you reach it before two seconds, you are too close. Increase the gap in rain, fog, or at higher speeds.

stem.en: How far before a turn must you signal in Florida?

text.en: At least 50 feet
At least 100 feet
At least 250 feet
Only when other traffic is present

explanation.en: Florida law requires you to signal a turn at least 100 feet (about 30 meters) before the turn.

stem.en: Your turn signals are not working. What hand signal indicates a left turn?

text.en: Left arm extended straight out horizontally
Left arm bent up at a 90-degree angle
Left arm bent down at a 90-degree angle
Right arm pointing left across the dashboard

explanation.en: For a left turn, extend your left arm straight out the window horizontally. Arm bent up = right turn. Arm bent down = stop or slow.

stem.en: What is the legal blood alcohol content (BAC) limit for a non-commercial Florida driver age 21 or older?

explanation.en: In Florida, a non-commercial driver age 21+ is legally impaired at 0.08% BAC. Drivers under 21 are limited to 0.02% (zero tolerance), and commercial drivers are limited to 0.04%.

stem.en: What is the BAC limit for Florida drivers under age 21?

explanation.en: Florida applies a 'zero tolerance' rule for drivers under 21: any BAC of 0.02% or higher results in an automatic license suspension.

stem.en: You are driving on a multi-lane road and approaching a stopped emergency vehicle with flashing lights on the shoulder. Florida's Move Over Law requires you to:

text.en: Continue at posted speed; the emergency vehicle is off the road
Move into a non-adjacent lane if safe; otherwise slow to 20 mph below the posted limit
Come to a complete stop until the emergency vehicle leaves
Honk to acknowledge the emergency vehicle

explanation.en: Florida's Move Over Law requires drivers to vacate the lane closest to a stopped emergency, law enforcement, sanitation, utility, or tow vehicle with flashing lights when safe. If you cannot move over, slow to 20 mph below the posted speed (or 5 mph if the posted speed is 20 mph or less).

stem.en: Your car begins to hydroplane in heavy rain. What should you do?

text.en: Brake hard to slow down quickly
Steer sharply to regain control
Ease off the accelerator and steer straight until you regain traction
Accelerate to push through the water

explanation.en: If you hydroplane, ease off the gas, keep the wheel pointed straight, and avoid hard braking. Sudden steering or braking can cause a skid. Once you feel traction return, slow down gradually.

stem.en: What is the speed limit in a Florida school zone when children are present (unless posted otherwise)?

text.en: 15 mph
20 mph
25 mph
30 mph

explanation.en: Unless otherwise posted, the school zone speed limit is 20 mph when children are present or during posted hours.

stem.en: Florida permit (Learner's License) holders must drive with:

text.en: Any licensed driver age 18 or older anywhere in the vehicle
A licensed driver age 21 or older in the front passenger seat
A parent or guardian only
No supervision required after the first month

explanation.en: A Florida permit holder must be accompanied at all times by a licensed driver age 21 or older who is occupying the closest seat to the driver. For the first three months they may only drive in daylight; afterward they may drive until 10 PM.

stem.en: Before taking the Class E knowledge exam, all first-time Florida applicants must complete:

text.en: A 30-hour behind-the-wheel course
The TLSAE (Traffic Law and Substance Abuse Education) 4-hour course
A defensive driving course
Six months of permit driving

explanation.en: All first-time Florida applicants of any age must complete the TLSAE — a 4-hour Traffic Law and Substance Abuse Education course — before they can take the Class E knowledge exam. Applicants under 18 must also complete the DETS 6-hour driver education course.
